caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely flat, and it is never predictable. I have spent years riding these mountain corridors, where a quiet canopy road quickly transitions into a steep clay climb that demands your absolute focus. This is where we test the terrain for My Adventure Costa Rica, making sure every route we design is as rewarding as it is challenging. Designed slowly, ridden at your own pace.
